caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a woven seat, shown head-on against an off-white or cream-colored background. The chair features two round, vertical posts on either side, each topped with a small sphere. Three horizontal, slightly arched slats connect the two side posts to form the backrest. The wood of the chair is depicted in various shades of brown, with some areas showing darker tones and others lighter, displaying a weathered appearance. The seat is woven and appears tan or light brown in color, with the weaving pattern clearly visible. Four horizontal stretchers connect the four legs near the floor, two on each side and one across the front and the back, providing stability. Shadows and subtle details suggest texture and depth in the wooden surfaces and woven seat. At the lower right corner of the page, the artist's signature “Sam W Ford Del - 526” is written in a reddish-brown color. There are no additional objects or details in the background.
title: Pennsylvania Ladder Back Chair
